items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
points: Led frontend architecture for a multi-tenant automotive dealer platform, built with Micro Frontend/Module Federation across CRM, SAT and white-label modules on one shared component system.
Cut page load time by 30%+ by migrating the build pipeline to Vite + Rollup and optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP: 3.8s → 2.6s).
Shipped a WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant healthcare portal with OAuth2/JWT auth, real-time GraphQL/WebSocket updates and integrated payments.
Built a booking & payment flow with 90% test coverage and SonarQube-enforced code quality.

items.title: Senior Frontend Developer
points: Mentored a team of 4 engineers on React/TypeScript best practices and accessibility standards, building the code review checklist the team still uses.
Used AI pair-programming (Claude, Cursor) to speed up delivery by about 30%, reviewing every AI-generated change for security issues before merge.
Built the SSR portal for a national government examination platform, cutting load time by 20% and shipping multi-language (i18n) support.
Rolled out accessibility tooling (axe DevTools) across projects and trained the team on WCAG 2.1 AA patterns.
